name: Vishing
description: Vishing involves calling target employees and using a fabricated pretext to extract information or manipulate behavior over the phone. In physical red teaming, vishing is typically used to gather intelligence before an in-person visit — identifying security vendors, shift schedules, access procedures — or to prime a target before on-site execution by calling ahead as 'IT support' to establish a reason to be there. A burner phone or VoIP service with caller ID spoofing capability prevents attribution.

blue.det: Call logs showing unusual inbound/outbound patterns; employee reports suspicious call requesting sensitive info; caller ID spoofing may show as internal or trusted number.
blue.cm: Caller ID verification policy — never trust inbound caller ID alone; call-back verification for sensitive requests; vishing simulation training; process requiring out-of-band confirmation for credential or access requests by phone.
